prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Ask the operator to check the vehicle records and the report.
3. Check the brake system. Check all parts of the brake system that have been fixed or repaired already:
    a. Brakes
    b. Pads
    c. Brake light
    d. ABS (AntiLock Braking System)
    e. Windshield washer
4. The inspector should write out why the brakes failed. See diagram.
5. Make sure the inspector followed the guidelines before making a conclusion about the brake failures.
6. Explain to the operator why the brakes failed (DO NOT use technical lingo)
7. Explain to the operator what the cause of the brakes was (if known and if appropriate, this may require a discussion with a mechanic)

## DIAGRAM:

1. The inspection will be documented in a report after it is completed.
2. The inspector will look at the brake assembly.
